description: A webhook. The URL and the signing secrets are never returned

modified_on.description: When the webhook was last changed

url_hint.description: Scheme, host and port (cut at 200 characters) and the first 40 characters of the path of the URL; never the query or the fragment. Empty while url_set is false

url_set.description: Whether a URL is stored. False for a webhook restored from a backup without secrets: enter the URL again

secret_set.description: Whether a signing secret is stored

secret_error.description: True when a stored URL or secret cannot be opened (it was saved with another key): save the webhook again with its URL

events.description: Event ids as in GET /notifications/events (an event a webhook can carry), or ["*"] for every event, also the ones added later. notification.test is never selected by "*".

enabled.description: Whether events are sent to the webhook

verify_tls.description: Whether the receiver's TLS certificate is verified (https only)

disabled_reason.description: Why NPMpro disabled it: gone (the receiver answered 410), failing (3 days of failures without a success) or restore (restored from a backup without secrets); null when it was not disabled by NPMpro

failing_since.description: When the first delivery failed since the last success; null when none is failing

last_success_on.description: When the last delivery succeeded; null when none did

secret.description: The signing secret (whsec_ and base64). Only in the answer that made it (a create, a rotation, or the save of a webhook restored without secrets): shown once, copy it now

last_delivery.description: The newest delivery of the webhook; null when there is none

status.description: Where the delivery is: pending (waiting for its first or next try), sending, sent, failed (no more tries) or dropped (the webhook was disabled)

http_status.description: The HTTP status of the last try; null when there was none or the request did not get an answer
